svg.title: Outcome of 3168 contour-index cells before and after the change
svg.text: Contour index out of range: BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet and MakeChamfer
One cell per (builder state, accessor, index), each run in its own process. 10 x 10 x 10 box, default Release build.
Each state shows the indices -1 0 1 2 3 100000 INT_MAX INT_MIN. A dark bar marks a valid index. Rows marked [J] take an edge index.
